findings.summary: ESCALATE_MARGIN is set to 0.5 instead of the 5.0 the accompanying doc comment and tests assume.
findings.mechanism: The doc comment two lines above explicitly states "`5.0` reproduces the old effective margin", and downstream tests (decide_escalates_when_threshold_equals_old_absolute_floor with threshold 85/score 82, and vmaf_worker_test.rs's below_threshold_with_room_escalates_and_bumps_retry with threshold 93/score 88) are written assuming a margin of 5.0 (boundary 80/88). With the actual constant at 0.5, the escalation boundary becomes 84.5/92.5, so score 82.0 (expected Escalating) and score 88.0 (expected Escalating) both fall below the boundary and resolve to RejectedTerminal instead — these tests fail, and in production the escalation band is only 0.5 points wide instead of 5, reproducing almost the same dead-band bug this change was meant to fix.
